Mateo / team — attached is a focused draft MAP for MediWorks (PDF + perf CSV). Summary below. Please review quickly; I will incorporate Laura/Ben notes and send to the customer EOD Thu.

Attachments: MW-Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf, performance-profiles.csv

Executive summary:
- Objective: Enable MediWorks to choose a hosting lane (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) by 2026-06-23 with an evidence-backed recommendation.
- POC window: 2026-06-11 -> 2026-06-24 (staggered tasks below)
- Decision gate: 2026-06-23 internal review with MediWorks; procurement signoff by 2026-06-30

Proposed evaluation steps (owners):
1) Quick functional POC (Hosted) — 2 business days (Priyom) — verify API, streaming, tool-calling
2) Perf run (Dedicated capacity, reserved short-term) — 3 days (Ben) — p50/p95 latency, throughput at target concurrents
3) Security/compliance review — KMS, audit logs, retention (Laura) — deliver evidentiary checklist
4) Cost delta analysis & quantization recommendation — (Priyom/Ben) — expected token cost for live traffic and footprint for Dedicated/private

Pass/fail gates (examples):
- Latency p95 <= 350ms on EU-hosted dedicated baseline -> Recommend Dedicated/Hosted
- Cost delta Dedicated vs Hosted <= 25% at target qps -> Recommend Dedicated when throughput critical
- Private recommended if legal requires on-prem KMS or air-gapped audit logs

Phased timeline (high-level):
- 06/11: Kickoff & credentials exchange
- 06/12–06/16: Functional POC (Hosted) + initial perf profiling
- 06/17–06/19: Short Dedicated perf run (reserved nodes)
- 06/20–06/22: Compliance review + procurement packet prep
- 06/23: Decision review (customer + Redwood)

Open asks for MediWorks to expedite:
- Provide sample traffic characteristics (tokens/req, concurrency), redaction rules, and any regulatory constraints for EU region.
- Procurement contact to coordinate DocuSign / contract timeline.

I’ll send a customer-facing PDF after Laura’s checklist is embedded.

Thanks,
Priyom
